title: Say hello
desc: Meet your new neighbor and ask about their day.

title: Order a coffee
desc: Get a drink and something to eat at a busy café.

title: Buy a bus ticket
desc: Ask for a ticket downtown and find out when the bus leaves.

title: Order dinner with a roommate
desc: Your roommate is hungry, find out what he wants.

title: Return a shirt
desc: Bring back a shirt that doesn't fit and ask for your money back.

title: Ask for directions
desc: Find your way to the train station.

title: Haggle at a market
desc: Talk the price of a souvenir down.

title: Negotiate your rent
desc: Your landlord wants more money. Talk them down.

title: Do a job interview
desc: Tell the recruiter what you're good at and what you're still learning.
